items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Did you meet him there? No, he was with me in the 30, [INTERVIEWEE] I'm at 32 in North Carolina City. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, but that was the same time you played the Suburban Garden.

ctx.x: Well, I don't think he is. Frank Briggs wanted a lot of international Southwest jazz musicians. And our friends to him as much as I possibly can. Now, let's see.
Lee Armstrong in 1931, he was on tour. He played the Suburban Gardens. He came all over. 31, he came through the South. Did you meet him there? No, he was with me in the 30,
I'm at 32 in North Carolina City. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, but that was the same time you played the Suburban Garden. Right, that was.
